messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-gateway (high 5xx rate)
pagerduty: Incident #INC-45321 created — 5xx error rate > 2% for 5m in region=us-west1. Pager sent to SRE rotation. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-45321
Sam: Acked. I'm on it. :thumbsup:
Anya: I see elevated 502/504s on the metrics dashboard, looks like a spike started ~10:42 UTC. Confirming customer impact (frontend errors spiking).
Lee: Adding runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-gateway-5xx
Marta: Noting customers: multiple low-latency prod tenants reporting degraded responses via support channel.
Sam: Quick checks — curl to /health returned 502 from a couple of hosts:

```
$ curl -s -D - https://gw-usw1.redwood/api/v1/health | head
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "status": "degraded",
  "kvcache_hits": 0
}
```
Anya: Prom query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway",status=~"5.."}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway"}[2m])) * 100` => 3.8% in us-west1, baseline 0.2%
Lee: Checking autoscaler events and pod restarts — `kubectl get hpa -n inference` shows no recent scale up, but `kubectl describe deploy/gateway` shows backlog of tcp reset errors.
Sam: Initial hypothesis — upstream model-serving pods (kvcache sidecar) are experiencing KV cache eviction storms causing fallthrough and 502s. Might be a memory pressure/GC causing stalls.
Marta: Are we seeing any host-level OOM or GPU saturation? infra-bot, can you pull host metrics for the last 15m for the affected nodes?
infra-bot: Gathering node metrics... attaching summary:
```
node-uw1-05: cpu 72%, mem 81%, GPU 58%
node-uw1-07: cpu 85%, mem 92% (swap activity), GPU 12%
node-uw1-08: cpu 35%, mem 40%, GPU 20%
```
Anya: node-uw1-07 looks unhealthy (high mem + swap). That could explain eviction of caches.
Sam: For mitigation: 1) remove node-uw1-07 from service (cordon + drain); 2) scale up gateway replicas by +3 as a quick buffer; 3) shift traffic to eu region for low-latency tolerant customers. Thoughts?
Lee: Agree. Start with cordon/drain of node-uw1-07, then scale. I'll execute cordon now.
Sam: Executing commands (will paste outputs):
```
kubectl cordon node-uw1-07
kubectl drain node-uw1-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```
Lee: Drain started — some pods are stuck Terminating (kvcache sidecars). I'm forcing restart on the sidecar to expedite.
Anya: While that's happening, configure a temporary routing policy: bias 30% of traffic to eu-west1 for requests > 2s latency. Updating routing config now.
Sam: Scaling gateway replicas:
```
kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=12 -n inference
```
infra-bot: Scale request accepted; new pods scheduled on healthy nodes.
Marta: Noting customer comms: posting to status page draft: "We are experiencing increased 5xx errors in us-west1. Mitigation underway; some customers may see degraded responses. We'll update within 30 minutes." Approving?
Sam: Approve. Post it and link support tickets.
Anya: After cordon/drain+scale, 5xx rate dropped to 0.9% within 3 minutes. Prom screenshots attached. Continuing to watch for 15m.
Lee: Follow-up: root cause appears to be a noisy model-host with runaway memory growth from a recent quantization path change. Opening a bug and tagging model-onboard.
Sam: For now, we'll keep the node cordoned and schedule a replacement for the model-host. Also plan a canary rollback of the quantization change in the model pool.
Marta: Escalation decision: not yet PD-escalate to SE. We'll do a normal incident track and notify impacted enterprise customers via account reps.
pagerduty: Incident #INC-45321 — acknowledged by Sam. Escalation timers paused.
Sam: Handing off to Anya for continued monitoring during the next 30m. I'll remain on-call if it regresses.
Anya: Will monitor dashboards and check the kvcache hit ratio. If 5xx crosses 2% again, we re-open PD and escalate.
infra-bot: node-uw1-07 has been drained and cordoned. New gateway pods distributed. Reclaiming suspicious VM for postmortem.
Sam: Good work team. Postmortem owner: Lee. Expected follow-ups: rollback quantization patch for model-variant v2.3, improve kvcache eviction metrics, add node memory-swap alarm. ETA for initial postmortem draft: 24h.
Marta: I'll update status page: "Mitigation in place; degraded performance reduced. Investigating root cause." Posted.
Lee: Filing bug: BUG-2026 - model-host memory growth after quantization optim. Assigned to model-onboard.
Sam: Closing PD incident for now; keep thread open for additional observations. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident #INC-45321 marked resolved (post-condition: 5xx rate < 1% sustained 10m). Auto-close countdown started.
Anya: Monitoring — all steady at ~0.3% now. I'll ping if anything changes.
Marta: Noted, prepping customer followup email template.
Sam: Thanks everyone. End of thread unless changes.
